// Wrong on purpose (F11): the fan-out rethrows only the first screen failure, so later failures are lost.
import type { ModuleContext } from "@get-modular/resources";
import type { QuotesDeps, QuotesProduct, Screen, Ticker } from "./h-requests.types.js";

export async function createQuotesModule(deps: QuotesDeps, { resources }: ModuleContext): Promise<QuotesProduct> {
  // One subscription for all tickers: each open ticker is a Set entry, not a watcher of the settings store.
  const screens = new Set<Screen>();
  const current = deps.settings.read(["eurUsd"]);
  deps.settings.watch(current, {
    resources,
    name: "quotes/rate",
    onChange: ({ values }) => {
      let failure: { readonly cause: unknown } | undefined;
      for (const screen of screens) {
        try {
          screen.show(values.eurUsd);
        } catch (cause) {
          failure ??= { cause };
        }
      }
      if (failure !== undefined) {
        throw failure.cause;
      }
    },
  });
  return {
    instance: undefined,
    capabilities: {
      "acme/quotes": {
        convert: (eur) => eur * deps.settings.read(["eurUsd"]).values.eurUsd,
        openTicker: (screen): Ticker => {
          screen.show(deps.settings.read(["eurUsd"]).values.eurUsd);
          screens.add(screen);
          return {
            close: async () => {
              screens.delete(screen);
            },
          };
        },
      },
    },
  };
}
